mentions.name: hoopi-pi-ng
mentions.description: This is a standalone audio processing engine and app with a web UI for the Raspberry Pi and other ARM-based single-board computers, letting the author use NAM models from tone3000 for guitar effects. It provides two channels with gains, a noise gate, NAM modeling, EQ, and reverb, and is open source.
